clips.title: The story
paras: Elling Trias sends you south to seek news of the missing diplomat. Leads in Stormwind point toward Duskwood and Watcher Backus, a contact near Darkshire who may know of Defias activity.

After a frustrating exchange with Jorgen, cheesemonger Elling Trias turns to his wider circle of informants. To save his own coin, he sends you to do the fieldwork instead of hiring agents. You carry a sealed missive across the border into Duskwood, where beasts and the undead make travel dangerous.

Watcher Backus serves in the Night Watch and patrols the northern approach to Darkshire. Trias trusts him to report illicit movements through Duskwood, despite the dangers on its roads. Show Backus the sealed dispatch, and he can share guard records and local gossip about Defias Brotherhood operations in the south.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Jorgen, you ol' sonuva.... So, that's how it's going to be, huh?
All right, I can deal with that. I hope he finds the Twisting Nether that much sooner!
Here's what's gonna happen, friend. I'll start using my contacts here, but you're doing most of the footwork so I save some coin.

Head to Darkshire in Duskwood and find Watcher Backus--he usually patrols the north road right outside of town. Just tell him you're looking into any Defias activity for me and he'll help you out with any information he can.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Not too safe to be traveling about in the woods, friend. Be careful, and if you see anything suspicious or dangerous, contact the Watchers immediately. Don't try and take anything on yourself. We're not responsible for anything terrible that might happen to you.
But we both know you're gonna ignore me and fight whatever comes out of the darkness anyway, don't we? Haha, yeah, you adventurer types... All the same.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, Trias sent you, huh? That's a little different.
Feel free to fight whatever monstrosities come at you from the darkness. I'm sure you'll be able to handle it pretty easily if you're the type to be hanging around with the likes of him.
So, what does my friend need of me on such a gloomy day as this?
